title: HelperSessionIntentStatusResult
description: Answers session.intent-status (nocx-6q1uh.5, spec §6.2): 'unknown' for a token this generation never minted or has since released its slot for, 'in_progress' while a bound intent is still resolving, or the terminal state a bound intent settled at — mirroring result.state when result is present. result carries the same compact record session.intent itself would answer, with regionOmitted set rather than a stale echo of the screen: the caller re-reads a fresh region instead.
